messages:
sasha: quick thread to lock down a minimal DP/beta scope for the coming sprint. propose a 3-week micro-beta, 6 partners (mix of hosted + private), strict owner list, and crystal clear acceptance criteria so PMs can prioritize roadmap asks. want a fast thumbs up.

michael: +1. confirm primary objectives? routing/fallback behavior, onboarding friction, and paired-eval signal collection?

sasha: exactly. prioritize routing + rollback validation first week, paired-eval collection week 2, perf + cost observations week 3.

ana: suggest intake requirement: each partner provides 10 representative prompt pairs and an infra contact before kickoff. also prefer human-paired evals over automatic metrics.

ravi: runtime ask: expose a single toggle to flip fallback per-partner (manual API) and limit exposed model variants to 2 to reduce risk. ETA for minimal toggle endpoint ~10d.

emily: CS input: target partners who already have SSO and existing infra; require weekly 20-min syncs and 5-question micro-survey after each sync. incentives: small product credit + gift card to reduce churn.

sasha: draft acceptance criteria below, please flag edits:
```
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (micro-beta)
- 6 partners committed; at least 5 active by EOW1
- First successful inference <=48h after activation
- Routing/fallback exercised & reproduced in staging >=2 times
- Paired-eval: 50-sample human preference test per partner; baseline win-rate >=90% or <=10pp regression
- Observability: token-level latency + per-route error budget visible in console
- Supportable: CS OK with SE time (<=6 concurrent partners)
```

ben: ops blocker: GPU quota may need an expedited request; i'll file immediately but flag risk.

michael: i'll draft the partner invite + trimmed data addendum and ping legal for quick review.

sasha: thanks — can everyone add one blocker by EOD? i'll consolidate and send invites tomorrow.

(dp-bot): Created ticket BETA-999 "micro-beta-6p-straight-to-signal" (assignee: michael).
